```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# Source the script that creates result_raw and result_ranked
source("load_vimp_tables.R")
```

## Raw values

```{r raw-table}
knitr::kable(
  result_raw,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Raw variable importance measures and estimated effects"
)
```

## Ranks

Rank 1 indicates the variable ranked as most important. For minimal depth,
smaller values receive better ranks.

```{r ranked-table}
knitr::kable(
  result_ranked,
  digits = 0,
  caption = "Ranks of variable importance measures and estimated effects"
)
```
